quick_facts.review_cadence: every sprint + after any security incident

rules.rule: All API endpoints require JWT authentication unless explicitly decorated @Public()
All roles-restricted endpoints use @Roles() decorator + RolesGuard
JWT access tokens expire in 15 minutes maximum
JWT secrets must be ≥ 32 chars, generated with openssl rand -hex 32
No secrets in .env files committed to git. .env is in .gitignore
All user inputs validated with class-validator. ValidationPipe whitelist:true globally
All DB queries use TypeORM parameterized queries. String interpolation in SQL is forbidden
Helmet.js enabled globally. CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options headers required
Rate limiting: 120 req/min global, 5 req/min on /auth/login
CORS configured to specific origins. Wildcard (*) is forbidden in production
Passwords stored as bcrypt hash (cost factor ≥ 10). Never plaintext
Store-scoped access: users can only read/write their own store's data
Never log passwords, tokens, or full PII. Log only IDs and operation names
Docker containers run as non-root user (USER node)
Dependencies audited monthly via npm audit. Critical/high CVEs fixed within 48 hours
